title: Chapter 20 I Would Rather Be A Chicken Mouth
content:
Chapter 20 I Would Rather Be A Chicken Mouth

"Win!" Ji Ying cheered and raised his chin at the others. The meaning was clear: Well, as I said, Brother Heifu is awesome!

"The winner can be determined so quickly?" The other seven people in the room also looked at each other, and they had not yet reacted...

"How is this going……"

Dongmen Leopard also had a look of disbelief on his face. He used to play arm wrestling with his peers in the county on the streets and under trees. He always used his right hand. This was his first time playing with his left hand, so he was not very skilled in exerting force and movements. But Heifu was as skilled as if he had practiced it thousands of times, and his strength was far beyond Dongmen Bao's imagination.

"I don't accept it!"

He held it in for a long time, then suddenly shouted, staring at Heifu with his eyes fixed on him: "Come again!"

"You are more open-minded than what you said before, but you are cheating when you lose. What kind of man are you!" Ji Ying was not happy and immediately made sarcastic remarks, which made Dongmen Bao blush.

"Ji Ying." Hei Fu waved his hand to stop him and said with a smile: "It doesn't matter if we do it again. In that case, how about winning two out of three games?"

"Okay!" Dongmen Bao gritted his teeth. He felt that he had been careless just now and underestimated Heifu too much. This time, he would be more careful.

The two squared off again and crossed their arms. This time, Dongmen Bao didn't dare to make any sarcasm. Instead, he pursed his lips tightly and stared at Hei Fu's posture.

To be fair, this time, they asked Ji Ying to call the start.

"Decision!"

After Ji Ying's voice sounded, Dongmen Leopard immediately used all his strength. This time, he was not knocked down by Heifu's explosive power, but was held at the midpoint.

But they saw their palms touching each other tightly, their arm muscles working hard, they raised their heads, their eyes met, and they both saw the tenacity in each other's eyes...

"This Dongmen Leopard, even with his left hand, has a lot of strength." Heifu knew that he had met his opponent, but it didn't matter, arm wrestling relied not only on strength, but also on skills.

He had played this game with his police school classmates in his previous life, so he knew that when arm wrestling, the most beneficial state for you to exert force is when you can see your five fingers from the front, instead of the fist facing you. In addition, according to the principle of leverage, when the opponent's arm is closer to you, it will also help you exert force.

So when the two of them were in a stalemate, Heifu began to adjust his posture slightly, and tried to pull Dongmen Bao's hand towards him, and then pressed it down hard!

"Here we go again!" Dongmen Leopard was forced to close his eyes and gritted his teeth. Veins popped out on his neck and forehead, and the three round birthmarks on his face became even redder. All his strength was concentrated on his left hand, but he still couldn't prevent it from being deflected little by little, and was finally crushed on the earth platform...

In the second arm wrestling, Heifu won again.

"I lost because you were so good. This long one is yours."

This time, Dongmen Leopard did not shout "Come again" and stood up with some frustration.

Seeing that Dongmen Bao, who had been so arrogant all day, actually surrendered, everyone in the room looked surprised and couldn't believe it. At the same time, they looked at Heifu's eyes, and their admiration became even more admirable, and those who were afraid were even more fearful.

After a battle, there is no doubt who is the leader in the room.

After Heifu won, he did not feel proud. Instead, he said to Dongmen Bao who was sulking on the spot: "Brother Bao, actually you did not lose."

"What do you mean by this?" Dongmen Leopard turned around immediately after hearing this.

Heifu raised his left hand and said, "I didn't have time to say it just now, but I am actually left-handed."

"Heifu, you win if you win, why do you say it!" Ji Ying was anxious. Seeing the arrogant Dongmen Leopard deflated, he was so happy. Unexpectedly, Heifu told all the facts, and he couldn't help but feel shocked. Shocked...

But Hei Fu didn't take it seriously and said deliberately: "I actually took advantage of this arm-wrestling. It's unfair to Dongmen Leopard. How can I hide it?"

After saying that, he bowed to the somewhat ashamed and angry Dongmen Leopard and said, "That's the way it is, today's contest doesn't count!"

Dongmen Bao's face was uncertain for a long time, countless thoughts flashed through his mind, but finally he slowly calmed down and sighed: "Left hand versus left hand, you didn't plot against me during the two decisive battles, but won openly and honestly, How can we talk about unfairness? Besides, you can tell the truth truthfully without hiding anything, so I know you didn’t intentionally deceive me..."

He cupped his hands and said, "If I lose, I lose. I have nothing to say. It's so long, just do it. I will never fight again!"

The reason why Heifu revealed the truth was that he would definitely be able to hide his little secret if we spent the next month together day and night. Secondly, it was also a bet on Dongmen Leopard's temperament. As expected, this reckless man also has his own arrogance.

He burst out laughing: "You are indeed a cheerful person!"

Heifu stepped forward very familiarly, patted Dongmen Bao on the shoulder and said: "Brother Bao, in my opinion, you and I are really indistinguishable in terms of strength and martial arts!"

"Is it hard to tell the difference?"

Dongmen Leopard muttered these two sentences, his anger completely disappeared, and he was actually a little happy.

Heifu had just become famous in the county, and young people were talking about his deeds and regarded him as a warrior. Although Dongmen Leopard is also a local leader, he is only famous in their east gate. Outside of that three-acre land, who still knows him?

How could he not be happy when Heifu, the brave warrior praised by the county people, said that the two of them were "indistinguishable"?

You must know that Dongmen Bao competed with Hei Fu just now because he wanted to gain fame by defeating Hei Fu. These young people in the village value this most. Sometimes, for the sake of reputation, there are many who stab themselves with a knife. . Now, even though he lost in the end, he has received sympathy and appreciation from the other party. Dongmen Leopard is still very useful.

Hei Fu struck while the iron was hot: "I have also heard of a saying, no fight, no acquaintance, so you and I can just pretend that today we are meeting friends by wrestling with each other, how about that?"

After being praised for a while, Dongmen Leopard nodded confusedly: "Okay! If we don't fight, we won't get to know each other!" He said and bowed to Hei Fu.

Now that we are friends, everything is easy to talk about.

"One more thing."

Heifu said to him again: "I wonder if you would like to be the corps commander of Benshi?"

Seeing Dongmen Bao's hesitation, probably because he didn't want to be inferior to others, Hei Fu persuaded him: "Actually, these chiefs and corps chiefs are just small officials the size of sesame seeds. They are not officially established, they are just temporary replacements. It’s not really high or low.”

With that said, Hei Fu winked at Ji Ying.

Although Ji Ying didn't like Dongmen Leopard, he listened to Heifu's words and knew that he must have his own considerations, so he took the lead and said: "Yes, the eight of us are all soldiers, how can we be qualified to be the captain? In my opinion, Heifu and Bao are the people with the highest title and martial arts skills in Benshi. They are really suitable to be military officials! Do you think so?"

"That's right." The others also agreed.

At this time, Dongmen Leopard was a little bit stuck, and after a while he reluctantly said: "In that case, then I will be the corps commander for a month..."

"It's a deal! You and I will work together!"

Heifu smiled and high-fived him, secretly saying that his strategy had indeed worked.

He had already thought about it. It would not be easy to survive this month's shift. Externally, Heifu wanted to be careful of the revenge of the generals. Internally, he wanted to control everything, so he fought for this special position. As the saying goes, you would rather be the queen of a chicken than a cow. Hei Fu's current status as a "cow" is out of reach, but now this "chicken's mouth" is something he is determined to win!

Dongmen Bao is a very interesting person. Although he is overbearing, he is a typical straightforward man of this era in terms of his conduct. As long as he is treated with sincerity and makes a heart-to-heart relationship with him, it is not difficult to surrender.

The two of them "sympathized with each other" here, and Uncle Chao, who had been watching by the wall, breathed a sigh of relief. As long as they didn't start a fight, he didn't have to brave the rain to complain.

But seeing that the two men had already divided up the positions of the commander and corps commander, Chao Bo, as a veteran who had served many times, couldn't help but remind him: "You two, these are the commanders and corps commanders who are more senior soldiers. It’s not up to us to have the final say.”

Dongmen Bao suddenly became unhappy. He glanced at him fiercely and cursed: "You are an old man. You are still a soldier at such an old age. How do you have the right to speak here?"

"I..." Uncle Chao was yelled back, his face turning red from holding back.

Hei Fu walked directly towards him, making Uncle Chao tremble with fear. Unexpectedly, Hei Fu bowed and said:

"Thank you, senior, for reminding me. Heifu is serving in the army for the first time and is not very clear about many things. In the next month, I will have to ask more advice from senior. Senior has said before that he will take good care of this little fellow countryman like me."

Hei Fu would like to talk to all kinds of people, and he would convince them with force and treat them with sincerity, such as Dongmen Bao, a somewhat chivalrous and reckless man. For older people like Uncle Chao, he would act like a junior and ask for advice, talk to them, and ask questions.

Chao Bo was immediately greatly benefited, and he explained all the rules of guard duty to Hei Fu.

It turns out that although the chiefs and corps commanders are only minor military officials and are temporary, they must be held by nobles. They only have two sergeants, Dongmen Bao and Hei Fu. The chief of the corps must be chosen from the two of them, but they have to wait until the two hundred generals agree tomorrow...

"Is it General Bin Bai or Chen Bai who is responsible for training the soldiers?" Heifu asked.

"It's General Chen. General Bin is in charge of the county soldiers." Chao Bo responded.

"That's no problem." Heifu breathed a sigh of relief. This way, the matter was settled.

Later, he asked what the watchman was going to do.

"In the first half of the month, we have to conduct military exercises, and in the second half of the month, we have to build cities, build bridges, and build roads..."

"What exactly do you train during military exercises?"

Heifu didn't understand things like building bridges and paving roads. What he was concerned about was, what exactly were the reservists training in this era? If it's shooting with a bow or killing on horseback, I'm sorry, but he really doesn't know how to do it.

Uncle Chao smiled, showing his yellowed teeth and said, "Nothing else, the main thing is the procession."

"A procession? That's it?" Heifu blinked and almost stopped laughing.

To put it bluntly, people who graduate from the Armed Police Academy can goose-step in their dreams!

In his previous life, he practiced these things for three full years!
